resources.string: Stellar illustration, not a resolved photograph. Axis and rotation are unknown.

Apparent daily motion comes from Earth’s rotation, not an orbit around Earth. Diameter and mass refer to Polaris Aa (2024); distance is approximately 447 light-years. Unknown parameters are shown as —.
Accelerated rotation. Drag freely; tap to restore the original axis.
Mean surface gravity and bulk density are estimates derived from mass and mean radius. Polaris is a pulsating star; these are reference approximations, not live measurements.
